registered_at_parent_commit_note: 8a3558a is the trunk (origin/feat/ecological-selection, merge of PR #82) that the freeze commit merges; no smoke or experimental run existed at this commit.
question: In the live world with energy-limited reproduction and starvation mortality, does food scarcity (live.food_cap) shift the population's mean body mass (live.trait_mass_mean)?
model_status: headless adapter verified; NOT a live-world experiment-ready claim

decisions_taken_by_lead_session.attribution: Fixed by the lead session under the project owner's delegation, 2026-11-17, before any smoke or experimental run. They are facts of this preregistration, not smoke outputs.

common_configuration_of_every_arm.rationale: ADR-0007 option A (QD-ECO = A, PR #82): without the drive floor and thirst steering a prey-only world went extinct in 2-4 of 5 seeds. Predators do not persist yet, so the experiment is prey-only; that is a stated limitation (plan section 11), not a strength.

arms.drift: scarce food + live.mutation_rate = 0.0 (P4 exists since PR #81)

decisions_taken_by_lead_session.h1: treatment - control on the tail mean of live.trait_mass_mean (samples with tick > 0.8 * T), with the materiality triple of thresholds below
decisions_taken_by_lead_session.h2: descriptive only: drift vs treatment (scarce_mut0 - scarce)
decisions_taken_by_lead_session.seeds: seed_k = 760001 + 1000*k, k = 0..11; smoke seed 999971 (absent from every experimental manifest)
decisions_taken_by_lead_session.duration_ladder: 18000 / 12000 / 6000 ticks, sample period 600, rung chosen ONCE from the smoke and locked in execution-lock.json before any experimental seed

drift_contrast_exact_initial_condition_d.note: absent == 0.05 (DEFAULT_MUTATION_RATE); compared against the scarce treatment, same seeds

placeholders.explanation: A manifest holds numbers only (it is parsed as ExperimentManifest), so a value the smoke must set is committed as a NEGATIVE SENTINEL no live key can accept: the live adapter refuses it at model construction, so an experimental manifest with a sentinel cannot be run by accident. The sentinel is replaced by the smoke-chosen value in a dated amendment commit (a block named amendment_N_smoke_set below plus the manifest edit), once, before any experimental seed.
placeholder_paths_allowed: manifests esel1-control-abundant / esel1-treatment-scarce / esel1-drift-scarce-mutation-off: initial_conditions live.founders and live.food_cap only
duration.duration_ticks (the experimental manifests carry the top rung 18000 until a --duration-rung step-down is locked in execution-lock.json)

N0.rule: smallest value >= 30 such that the smoke population never falls below 5 agents at ANY sample at either food_cap value tried

F_hi.rule: FoodSpawnSettings::default().max_food_count (50) unless it overshoots the 80-prey reproduction gate within the first 1000 ticks, in which case the nearest lower value, stated explicitly

F_lo.rule: largest of {1/2, 1/3, 1/4, 1/8} * F_hi whose smoke mean live.standing_crop (or live.food_items) over the second half of the smoke is within +-20% of half of F_hi's, AND the smoke population does not go extinct; if none satisfies both, stop and file a finding; the extinction constraint is never relaxed

duration_rung.rule: highest rung of 18000 / 12000 / 6000 whose estimated total run time is <= 90 minutes (smoke measures microseconds per tick on the top rung); never lower N

h1_direction.rule: two_sided unless the smoke at seed 999971 plus the stated mechanism (small bodies are cheaper to run vs large bodies buffer starvation) justifies one direction; fixed once in a dated direction_fixed_after_smoke block, never changed after an experimental seed has run

smoke_may_set_only.must_not_be_chosen_by: any body-mass outcome (F_lo is chosen by food and survival only)
smoke_may_set_only.smoke_starting_candidates_in_smoke_manif: esel1-smoke-abundant.json carries live.founders = 30, live.food_cap = 50; esel1-smoke-scarce.json carries live.food_cap = 25 (the 1/2 candidate). These are the first candidates, not results; further candidates of the grid may be tried by editing ONLY those two keys in the smoke manifests, which are excluded from analysis.

hypotheses.direction: [SMOKE: fixed once after smoke, else two_sided]

hypotheses.contrast: drift (scarce, mutation off) vs treatment (scarce): delta = scarce_mut0 - scarce
hypotheses.rationale: descriptive only; does not separate selection from drift (plan section 5.3)
a drift in closed EU, or live.births == 0 while the population grew, is filed as a defect finding, not as biology

seeds.rule: seed_k = 760001 + 1000*k for k in 0..11, fixed before any run; disjoint from E2 700001.., E3 draft 730001.., E2R 750001..
seeds.smoke_seed_exclusion_is_mechanical: 999971 is absent from every experimental manifest's seed list, and run_manifest_seed returns RunStatus::Failed{SeedNotInManifest} for a seed the manifest does not declare.

duration.ladder_rule: Chosen ONCE from the smoke, before any experimental seed runs, written to execution-lock.json. Never changed after an experimental seed has run.

extinction_rule.handling: recorded outcome; the pair is dropped from the paired statistic and counted in the report with seed, arm and tick; never silently
extinction_rule.fewer_than_10_complete_pairs: insufficient_evidence; no replacement seeds, N is never changed

thresholds.between_rule: detectable but below the preregistered materiality threshold; counts as NOT different enough

reporting.failed_runs: every failed run is reported with its seed and reason; none is dropped

cost.reference_measured: E2: 24 runs x 18000 ticks at 10 agents = 157 s (Windows, July) and 66.9 s (macOS arm64, 2026-11-16 re-run)
cost.this_experiment: larger populations (>= 30 founders, reproduction on) cost more per tick; UNMEASURED, to be measured in the smoke and recorded in cost.measured_us_per_tick_release
cost.runs: 36 (control, treatment and drift arms x 12 seeds)
cost.on_budget_exceeded: step down the duration ladder using the smoke only, before any experimental seed runs; never lower N

reproduction_command: cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --release --features desktop --example run_esel1_experiment -j 2; then execute src-tauri/target/release/examples/run_esel1_experiment --ensemble --manifest-dir src-tauri/tests/fixtures/experiments_esel1 --out artifacts/experiments/e-sel1-food-scarcity
smoke_command: cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --release --features desktop --example run_esel1_experiment -j 2; then execute src-tauri/target/release/examples/run_esel1_experiment --smoke --manifest-dir src-tauri/tests/fixtures/experiments_esel1 --out artifacts/experiments/e-sel1-food-scarcity
smoke_exclusion: seed 999971 only in smoke manifests; absent from every experimental manifest

blocking_preconditions.evidence: live.locomotion (ADR-0006) on the trunk: PR #76 (merge 55ce76c), opt-in; plus the ADR-0007 option A drive floor and thirst steering, PR #82 (merge 8a3558a, feature commit 40aefe1). Every arm sets live.locomotion = 1, live.drive_floor = 0.5, live.thirst_steering = 1.
src-tauri/examples/run_esel1_experiment.rs (--smoke, --ensemble, --replay, execution-lock.json) with its tests, PR #81 (merge 6c2891d); never cargo run.
live.mutation_rate manifest key (absent == 0.05), PR #81 (merge 6c2891d); the drift arm exists and is included.
F-039 live.births counts continuous births: commit b0a8c4d on the trunk (PR #66 line); re-confirmed at freeze time by src-tauri/tests/live_births_bookkeeping_tests.rs.

decision_rule.shift_in_model_only_if: H1 reaches materiality AND >= 10 complete pairs AND no harness-integrity finding is open AND cargo test --features desktop is green
decision_rule.null_if: H1 is null or below materiality with >= 10 complete pairs
decision_rule.insufficient_evidence_if: fewer than 10 complete pairs, or a blocking precondition was satisfied in a way that departs from this preregistration
decision_rule.defects_are_not_insufficiency: a real defect found during the run is recorded and fixed as a defect

limitations_stated_in_advance: prey only (predator_fraction = 0): predators do not persist yet; no predation pressure
one terrain (the adapter's fixed map seed) and the headless adapter
body mutation probability is a declared constant per arm (0.05 or 0.0), not an experimental dose
drive floor 0.5 makes speed less heritable (a viability aid, ADR-0007)
will_not_be_claimed: adaptation or local adaptation (CM-S11 not run)
anything about predators, Red-Queen coevolution (S43) or brains
generality beyond one terrain seed and the headless adapter
